author: LLM supervisor (session of Issue #25)
created_at_checkpoint: after registration commit 921a8d6, during study pretrain; validated and first run on non-study smoke checkpoints (seed 999)
purpose: Reconcile block-swap IIA (1.0) with exemplar-copy success (~0.55, T001) by stratifying swap success over source/base attributes.
hypothesis: H-style: the fit-pool sources include word-number and abbreviated-unit surface forms that pretraining never showed (PRETRAIN_LESSON has no style); their block codes are off-distribution. Prediction: canonical-style sources >= 0.9, non-canonical-style sources markedly lower. Competing: H-pool (train vs dev tuples) or H-family (cross-family) explain the gap instead.
read_scope: model copies; dev-tuple force examples of the given families; ctx.observe.fit_pool; never sealed
measurement_definitions: swap success = argmax of head(h_base with h[0:16] replaced by h_src[0:16]) equals M_src*A_base*S_base mod 13; only pairs whose target differs from the base answer are scored; bases are canonical style (digits, full units)
